text: I am Dr. Agent. You mention a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; to narrow this down, are these symptoms limited to the hands, or do they also affect your feet?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Secondary syphilis.

The progression from a pruritic rash on the upper body and face to neuropathic symptoms (numbness and tingling) in a patient with livestock exposure is highly suggestive of secondary syphilis, specifically involving tabes dorsalis or early neurological involvement. I will confirm this with blood work.

REQUEST TEST: RPR and Treponema pallidum PCR.
REQUEST IMAGES: Full body skin exam to look for palmar/plantar rash distribution.
